notes: - contradiction: "Lonchidion minimorsus is a small hybodont shark species that lived during the Late Triassic period." / "The genus Lonchidion has a fossil record from the Carnian to the Maastrichtian, spanning 237 to 66 million years ago, and persisted until the very end of the Cretaceous.": Sentence 1 states the species lived during the Late Triassic, while sentence 6 claims the genus persisted until the end of the Cretaceous (66 Ma), which contradicts the species’ temporal range.
